StateDef.description:
A state within a state machine.

States can declare entry/exit side effects as string references
and carry optional metadata for rendering hints.

description.description: Description of what this state means.

is_final.description: Whether this is a terminal state.

on_enter.description: Side effects triggered on entering this state (string references).

on_exit.description: Side effects triggered on exiting this state (string references).

Transition.description:
A transition between two states, triggered by an event.

Guards gate the transition; actions fire when the transition is taken.
Both are string references resolved externally.

actions.description: Side effects executed when transition fires (string references).

description.description: Description of what this transition represents.

event.description: Event name that triggers this transition.

guard.description: Guard condition (string reference, resolved at runtime).

description.description: Description of what this state machine models.

initial_state.description: Name of the initial state (must exist in states).

title: StateMachine
